title: Pocketwire Savings Vault Time Lock Terms
content:
A Pocketwire Savings Vault can be time-locked where the tier offers time locks, for between the tier's shortest and longest lock in calendar days; locking is the customer's own decision.

## Lock terms by tier

| | Pocketwire Vault Essential | Pocketwire Vault Select | Pocketwire Vault Preferred | Pocketwire Vault Premier | Pocketwire Vault Reserve | Pocketwire Vault Private |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Time lock available | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Shortest time lock | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 30 calendar days |
| Longest time lock | 365 calendar days | 365 calendar days | 365 calendar days | 730 calendar days | 730 calendar days | 1095 calendar days |
| Lock can be ended early at the customer's request | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Early end forfeits the time-lock bonus interest already posted | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Terms

1. An active vault is time-locked by the customer until a chosen date, the lock end date; while locked the vault's status is time-locked.
2. The lock ends on its lock end date, and the vault returns to active.
3. A lock can be ended early only where the tier allows it, and then the time-lock bonus interest already posted for that lock is taken back where the tier's terms provide for forfeiture.
4. A representative cannot end a lock early on a tier that does not allow it, whatever the customer's reason.

## What each tier permits

| Tier | Can lock | Can end the lock early | On an early end |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Vault Essential | No | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Pocketwire Vault Select | No | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Pocketwire Vault Preferred | Yes | No | Not applicable |
| Pocketwire Vault Premier | Yes | Yes | Time-lock bonus interest already posted for that lock is taken back |
| Pocketwire Vault Reserve | Yes | Yes | Time-lock bonus interest already posted for that lock is taken back |
| Pocketwire Vault Private | Yes | Yes | Time-lock bonus interest already posted for that lock is taken back |

## Boundary cases

- A lock of 30 calendar days is the shortest allowed on every tier that offers locks; a lock of 29 calendar days is too short.
- On Pocketwire Vault Preferred a lock of 365 calendar days is the longest allowed and one of 366 is too long; on Pocketwire Vault Premier and Reserve the longest is 730 calendar days, and on Pocketwire Vault Private 1095 calendar days.
- On Pocketwire Vault Preferred a customer's request to end a lock before its lock end date cannot be met, whatever the reason given.
